description: This file contains API client utilities for interacting with backend endpoints, including health checks, test case management, run management, and AI authoring functions. It defines functions for making HTTP requests, handling JSON responses, and exporting public API functions.

methods.name: requestJson
methods.description: A helper function that performs fetch requests with error handling, JSON parsing, and optional signal support.

methods.name: getHealth
methods.description: Pings the backend health endpoint and returns the response as JSON or text.

methods.name: listTestCases
methods.description: Retrieves a list of test cases with optional pagination.

methods.name: getTestCase
methods.description: Fetches a single test case by its ID.

methods.name: createTestCase
methods.description: Creates a new test case with provided payload.

methods.name: updateTestCase
methods.description: Updates an existing test case identified by ID.

methods.name: deleteTestCase
methods.description: Deletes a test case by ID.

methods.name: startRun
methods.description: Starts a new test run with specified payload.

methods.name: listRuns
methods.description: Lists recent test runs with optional pagination.

methods.name: getRun
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific run by ID.

methods.name: getRunLogs
methods.description: Fetches logs for a specific run.

methods.name: aiGenerateTest
methods.description: Requests AI to generate a test draft based on a scenario description.

methods.name: aiImproveTest
methods.description: Requests AI to improve an existing test case by ID.
